prompt: I want you to help me create a 60-second motion graphics explainer video about the history of computers, from their origins to the modern era. All visual images should be handled by Jimeng, and all motion graphic elements and animations should be handled by you. The artistic style is a newspaper collage mixed-media aesthetic with high sophistication. This piece will be used for your portfolio, so please ensure it is outstanding.
